content:
Here you can ask Nuka Knights questions and we will then answer them for you. You can always find the team's answers above. But everyone is allowed to answer questions. 

So we have our own social network, just for Fallout 76. Independent of major providers.

Also take a look at the new private messages. Or feel free to upload your favorite outfits in the “Hot or Not” section. All members can then distribute their likes to you. The most popular outfits are always displayed here and are updated every few days.

Also click through the surveys. There we will always ask the community's opinion on current topics. This is how we find out what the majority of the community really wants. Provided that as many of you as possible take part.

Have fun!
